name: example-prompt-ab
notes: Template: one model, four prompt levers vs baseline. Each lever maps to a production mechanism — see scripts/rpd/README.md.

variants.guidance: HOOK-FIRST: the product must be unmistakably identifiable within the first second; the opening frames carry the whole ad.

directives.objective: Objective: Create a premium product commercial using subtle Ken Burns camera moves. Open on the tightest compelling detail and pull back to reveal. Must feel luxury while keeping 100% fidelity to the original product.

patch.find: Transitions: Smooth crossfades only, ~0.25s. No wipes, flashes, or animated transitions.
patch.replace: Transitions: Hard cuts only. No crossfades, wipes, flashes, or animated transitions.
